title.narrative: 22F-PbN - Wassa Amenfi Cocoa Landscape Initiative, Ghana

description.narrative: DGBP 2022. Above and beyond: Raising the social and environmental bar for impacts from sustainable sourcing of cocoa in Ghana

The objective of the partnership project is to demonstrate a commercially attractive model for landscape-level sustainability planning and responsible sourcing, with the potential to improve the social and environmental sustainability of cocoa farming in West Africa. The project aims to tackle deforestation and poverty associated with cocoa production by designing and implementing a responsible sourcing model that offers tailored solutions to cocoa communities; further strengthened by multi-stakeholder collaboration and research. This will promote conversion to profitable cocoa agroforestry, production of ecosystem services, diversification of on- and off-farm revenue sources, and increased climate resilience in crop systems.
The Danida Green Business Partnerships (DGBP) programme funds and supports market-based partnership projects between commercial and non-commercial partners addressing climate and environmental challenges while contributing to inclusive growth and improved livelihoods. The programme builds on previous years’ experience with the private partnership program, DMDP.
